title: When and where are the 'No Kings Day' rallies in the Sacramento region for Oct. 17 - NewsBreak
text:
By Veronica Fernandez-Alvarado ,
10 hours ago Tiffany Day, of Penn Valley, carries a “Blessed be the fight” sign as wears a costume from the Handmaid’s Tale during the “No Kings” protest in the Capitol on Saturday, June 14, 2025. HECTOR AMEZCUA/hamezcua@sacbee.com “ No Kings Day ” demonstrations return Saturday, Oct. 17, with rallies focusing on voting participation and making sure every eligible voter has a plan, knows their options and is ready to make their voice count, according to No Kings website.
The coordinated day of action comes a little more than a year after nationwide protests on June 14 , when more than five million people nationwide participated, including an estimated 5,000 demonstrators at the California state Capitol. That event coincided with a military parade in Washington, D.C., celebrating the U.S. Army’s 250th anniversary and President Donald Trump’s birthday.
Since organizers have held additional demonstrations protesting a federal government shutdown, mass deportations and attacks on healthcare and environmental protections.
Here is the schedule of No King events in the greater Sacramento region on Oct. 17:
